name: SIB-1553A
summary: SIB-1553A is a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist that is selective for receptors with a β4 subunit. Administration of SIB-1553A improved memory and attention in a Parkinson's disease model.

pharmacology.text: SIB-1553A is a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist that is selective for receptors with a β4 subunit.
